---
name: 🚀 Feature Request
about: Propose a new capability, policy rule, regulatory mapping, or integration.
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What Problem Does This Solve?

Describe the gap this feature addresses. Be specific: which layer does it affect — ingress proxy, policy engine, circuit breaker, or audit ledger?

## Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed implementation. Include:
- Which file(s) would change (`src/engine.py`, `config/policy.json`, etc.)
- Whether this requires a Python code change or just a policy config update
- Estimated effort (small / medium / large)

## Regulatory Justification (if applicable)

If this feature maps to a specific regulatory requirement, cite it:

- [ ] EU AI Act — Article: ___
- [ ] NIST AI RMF — Function/Category: ___
- [ ] ISO/IEC 42001 — Clause: ___
- [ ] Other: ___

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider and why did you rule them out?

## Additional Context

Add any relevant references, links to regulatory text, or prior art from other governance tools.
